Standard: Provisions exist for bleeding free air from each hydraulic system. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review of documentation such as system design drawings and specifications to verify the location of air bleed ports.
(2) Review of maintenance procedures to verify that methods for air removal are documented. Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct on air vehicle ground demonstration to verify air removal procedures.
